# Retrieved: 2026-10-06
# Assumptions: GLOBAL-1, HIER-1 (global policies, hierarchical format)
# Note: 'show security policies global' with from-zone and to-zone lists (relative to security policies global).
# Note: Text copied verbatim from the page <pre> block (line endings normalized, trailing spaces kept).
# ---
[edit]
user@host# show security policies global
policy Pa {
    match {
        source-address any;
        destination-address any;
        application any;
        from-zone [ zone1 zone2 ];
        to-zone [ zone3 zone4 ];
    }
    then {
        permit;
    }
}
